pain_point: Worried about Truganina infrastructure - Is the infrastructure keeping up with development out there? Roads parking services?
primary_text: "Is the infrastructure keeping up with development out there?" Drive through Truganina's industrial precinct today and the answer is obvious. Sealed arterial roads, roundabouts, dedicated truck routes, and commercial services within minutes. This area has been master-planned to handle industrial growth — not thrown together as an afterthought. The Princes Freeway interchange is minutes away. The West Gate Tunnel connects you to the CBD and port without the Bridge Road chaos. These off-the-plan warehouses are within a completed estate with kerbing, drainage, street lighting, and allocated parking. Infrastructure isn't catching up here — it's leading. Book a site visit.
description: Master-planned estate with sealed roads, drainage, lighting, and parking
